Partial key matching in setMutationDefaults yes. everything that takes a filter argument has partial support, as { exact: boolean } is part of the filter. For everything that affects multiple things, like cancelQueries, invalidateQueries, getQueriesData etc (with the plural queries in the name), exact defaults to false, meaning it matches fuzzily. Every piece of data cached by TanStack Query is identified by a query key — a serializable array that serves as both a cache address and a coordination primitive. Understanding how keys are structured, hashed, matched, and managed is the single most impactful skill for building predictable, performant applications with TanStack Query.
